segments.en: Due to fear, a woman miscarries. A segulah (conducive) for a woman that miscarriages with stillborns, is that she should carry with her a magnet.

segments.he:
ב.

סְגֻלָּה לְמַפֶּלֶת נְפָלִים שֶׁתִּשָּׂא אֶצְלָהּ מַגְנֵט, גַּם תִּשָּׂא אֶצְלָהּ חֲתִיכַת עֵץ מִקֶּבֶר הַצַּדִּיק, גַּם יִתֵּן צְדָקָה.
segments.en: Also, she should carry with her a piece of wood from the grave of a Tzaddik. Also, she should give charity. A woman who is prone to miscarry should carry with her dew-water.

segments.he:
ג.

אִשָּׁה שֶׁהִיא מַפֶּלֶת, תִּשָּׂא אֶצְלָהּ מֵי טַל.
segments.en: A segulah (conducive) for one who miscarries, is that she should sell her fetus.
On account of the sin of needless hatred, a woman miscarries stillborns.

segments.he:
ה.

בַּעֲווֹן שִׂנְאַת-חִנָּם הָאִשָּׁה מַפֶּלֶת נְפָלִים.
segments.en: Through her lust for food and drink, she miscarries. A woman who miscarries stillborns should not go with golden jewelry.

segments.he:
ו.

עַל-יְדֵי תַּאֲוַת אֲכִילָה וּשְׁתִיָּה שֶׁלָּהּ הִיא מַפֶּלֶת.
segments.en: 25. When a new king or a new minister arises, livelihood is renewed and undergoes change.

segments.he:
א.

אִשָּׁה הַמַּפֶּלֶת נְפָלִים, לֹא תֵּלֵךְ בְּקִשּׁוּטֵי זָהָב.
segments.en: 26. One who has dealings and business with non-Jews at the time of their festivals, or even not at the time of their festivals – but his revenue is from supplying things for their idolatry, through this his wife has bleeding shortly after her ritual immersion.

segments.he:
ב.

הַטְּחִינָה שֶׁל קֶמַח וְהַלִּישָׁה שֶׁל הַמַּצּוֹת שֶׁל פֶּסַח הִוא סְגֻלָּה לְאִשָּׁה, שֶׁמַּפֶּלֶת נְפָלִים.
segments.en:
27. One who makes a separation between a man and his wife -- that is, he goes to the man and praises his wife to him, but goes to the wife and defames the husband in her eyes, until a separation is created between them -- he becomes troubled (preoccupied, overtaken) by his expenses (for food or sustenance).

The grinding of flour and kneading of the matzah of Passover is a segulah (conducive) that miscarries with stillborns.
